description: WANDa performance data: customer contacts, network events, water quality samples and flush records. One CSV per kind (UTF-8, header row = the field names below, in this order). Equal to the PLDR STANDARD template that every client may already import (no app change).

types.ref: text exactly as delivered (a float id 12345.0 is written 12345; leading zeros kept); never changed
types.text: free text as delivered (phone numbers / e-mail addresses inside free text are removed)
types.code: a code from the field's code list
types.datetime: ISO 8601 yyyy-mm-dd, or yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss when a time is known
types.number: decimal number, '.' as decimal point, no thousands separator
types.bool: '1' = yes, blank = not said (the PLDR reader reads any non-blank text as yes)

contacts.description: Customer contacts (one row per contact). Minimum: contact_date + one location field.

fields.name: case_ref
fields.description: Client case reference (several contacts may share a case)

fields.name: contact_type
fields.description: The client's own contact type / reason, as delivered (kept for audit)

fields.name: pipe_ref
fields.description: Client pipe reference, when the client gives one

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) - when no x/y is given

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) - when no x/y is given

fields.name: postcode
fields.description: UK postcode (when blank the app takes it from the end of address)

fields.name: client_dma_ref
fields.description: The client's DMA reference for the contact

fields.name: dmz
fields.description: Client area level: district metered zone / control group, as delivered

fields.name: manager_area
fields.description: Client area level: operational / manager area, as delivered

fields.name: region
fields.description: Client area level: region / division / management area, as delivered

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Client area level: water supply / water quality zone, as delivered

network_events.description: Network events: bursts, mains / service repairs, customer-side leaks, valve operations, isolations, rezones, flushes. Minimum: event_date + one location field.

fields.name: case_ref
fields.description: Linked client case or contact reference

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: When the event was raised / happened

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: WI event type (the PLDR template derives its category from it)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Same as event_type (kept for the template)

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) - when no x/y is given

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) - when no x/y is given

fields.name: client_dma_ref
fields.description: The client's DMA reference for the event

fields.name: diameter
fields.description: Pipe diameter as delivered (a bare number is mm; a band such as '300 - 450mm' is kept)

fields.name: material
fields.description: Pipe material as delivered; the app normalises it to the WI material code list

fields.name: dmz
fields.description: Client area level: district metered zone / control group, as delivered

fields.name: manager_area
fields.description: Client area level: operational / manager area, as delivered

fields.name: region
fields.description: Client area level: region / division / management area, as delivered

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Client area level: water supply / water quality zone, as delivered

wq_samples.description: Water quality results: one row per determinand result in a sample. Minimum: sample_date + determinand + one location field.

fields.name: determinand
fields.description: The client's determinand name as delivered (the app reads the WI determinand from its words, incl. 'unflushed')

fields.name: value
fields.description: Result value in the delivered units

fields.name: units
fields.description: Units of value as delivered (the app converts to the determinand's WI unit)

fields.name: flushed
fields.description: '1' = flushed sample; blank = not said (the app reads 'unflushed' in the determinand name)

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Latitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) - when no x/y is given

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Longitude, WGS84 (EPSG:4326) - when no x/y is given

fields.name: client_dma_ref
fields.description: The client's DMA reference for the sample

fields.name: dmz
fields.description: Client area level: district metered zone / control group, as delivered

fields.name: manager_area
fields.description: Client area level: operational / manager area, as delivered

fields.name: region
fields.description: Client area level: region / division / management area, as delivered

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Client area level: water supply / water quality zone, as delivered

flush_records.description: Flush / conditioning records: one row per flush (or per hydrant used; rows of one DMA and date merge into one flush).

fields.name: udf
fields.description: '1' = unidirectional flush (every pipe in the DMA), blank = not said
